title: Citadel
tagline: One-stop portfolio management and analysis platform.
description:
It saves one time and effort to log into multiple exchanges and de-fi protocols and having to connect multiple wallets to track their investments. Citadel is the go-to platform for a trader/investor where one can integrate all their wallet addresses and track assets across various decentralised and centralised exchanges and across multiple chains, they can examine the analysis of their investments in the form of charts and other forms to make better investing decisions. they can personalize the assets they want to track especially and fetch real time prices as well.
